svg.title: ZAVA composite architecture: Epic Cogito Cloud, Azure and AWS, version 1
svg.desc: Editable vector redraw of Customer-Composite-Architecure-Azure-AWS.png, using the visual language of the supplied architecture-and-implementation sample. The cloud panel shows Epic Azure Cogito on Fabric in non-production and production, SQL endpoints, Entra cross-tenant trust, ZAVA identities, groups and service principals, an Azure subscription with private endpoints, and a firewall. The hybrid panel retains the separate Epic-hosted Cogito platform and its firewall, the ZAVA Edge firewall, the Azure-to-Edge and Edge-to-AWS site-to-site VPNs, hospital locations with Cogito Report Viewer and unconfirmed Power BI, and Site A and Site B data centers. All seven source configuration items are retained. Matching A badges continue the Azure VPN across panels. Connections are undirected, as in the source. This is a conceptual restyling, not a validated deployment or a claim that Microsoft Copilot generated this file. The original PNG is retained unchanged.
svg.metadata: Source author: Sam Cook. Source date: 2026-07-01. Source drawing label: cogito-cloud-connectivity.vsdx. Redraw version: 1.
